CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.default.assetmetadatastaging(
  assetMetadataKey                 STRING    NOT NULL,
  assetId               STRING,
  assetName               STRING,
  assetPath             STRING,
  attributeId           STRING,
  attributeName         STRING,
  attributeDescription  STRING,
  attributeDataType     STRING,
  attributeUnits        STRING,
  pointId               BIGINT,
  pointName             STRING,
  source                STRING,
  `time`                TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT assetmetadatastaging_pk PRIMARY KEY ( assetMetadataKey)
)
USING DELTA
COMMENT 'Asset metadata staging';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.default.assetmetadata(
id                    BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
  assetMetadataKey                 STRING    NOT NULL,
  assetId               STRING,
  assetName               STRING,
  assetPath             STRING,
  attributeId           STRING,
  attributeName         STRING,
  attributeDescription  STRING,
  attributeDataType     STRING,
  attributeUnits        STRING,
  pointId               BIGINT,
  pointName             STRING,
  source                STRING,
  `time`                TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT assetmetadata_pk PRIMARY KEY ( assetMetadataKey)
)
USING DELTA
COMMENT 'Asset metadata';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.default.missedpointchanges (
    `_id`                     BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1),
    `_model`                  STRING,
    `_timestamp`              BIGINT,
    `PipelineName`            STRING,
    `LastRunMaxTime`          TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
    `CurrentSubscriptionTime` TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
    `_name`                   STRING,
    `ArrayOfPoints`           STRING,
    `Id`                      STRING,
    CONSTRAINT missedpointchanges_pk PRIMARY KEY (`_id`)
)
USING DELTA;
Delete from workspace.default.missedpointchanges where _id = {{this.Id}}
Select * from MissedPointChanges order by _id
Select * from workspace.default.missedpointchanges order by _id limit 1
SELECT * from AssetMetadata where PointId >= 0
Select * from pointchanges where pointid = 1998
Truncate Table workspace.default.assetmetadatastaging;
Truncate Table MissedPointChanges;

MERGE INTO workspace.default.assetmetadata AS t
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT (rn) FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY assetMetadataKey ORDER BY `time` DESC) AS rn
    FROM workspace.default.assetmetadatastaging
  ) WHERE rn = 1
) AS s
ON t.assetMetadataKey = s.assetMetadataKey
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  assetId = s.assetId, assetName = s.assetName, assetPath = s.assetPath, attributeId = s.attributeId,
  attributeName = s.attributeName, attributeDescription = s.attributeDescription,
  attributeDataType = s.attributeDataType, attributeUnits = s.attributeUnits,
  pointId = s.pointId, pointName = s.pointName, source = s.source, `time` = s.`time`
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
  (assetMetadataKey, assetId, assetName, assetPath, attributeId, attributeName, attributeDescription,
   attributeDataType, attributeUnits, pointId, pointName, source, `time`)
VALUES
  (s.assetMetadataKey, s.assetId, s.assetName, s.assetPath, s.attributeId, s.attributeName, s.attributeDescription,
   s.attributeDataType, s.attributeUnits, s.pointId, s.pointName, s.source, s.`time`)
SELECT  * from AssetMetadata order by id limit {{this.Limit}} offset {{this.Offset}}
SELECT  * from AssetMetadata where PointId >= 0 order by id limit {{this.Limit}} offset {{this.Offset}}
CHECKPOINT;
SELECT  count(*) as count from AssetMetadata where PointId >= 0

CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS asset_metadata_id_seq START 1;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS AssetMetadata (
    id                   BIGINT      NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('asset_metadata_id_seq'),
    assetMetadataKey             VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    assetId              VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    assetName              VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    assetPath            VARCHAR,
    attributeId          VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    attributeName        VARCHAR,
    attributeDescription VARCHAR,
    attributeDataType    VARCHAR,
    attributeUnits       VARCHAR,
    pointId              INTEGER,
    pointName            VARCHAR,
    source               VARCHAR,
    PRIMARY KEY (assetMetadataKey)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assetmetadata_pointname
    ON AssetMetadata (pointName);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assetmetadata_assetmetadatakey
    ON AssetMetadata ( assetMetadataKey);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS AssetMetadataStaging (
    assetMetadataKey             VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    assetId              VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    assetName              VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    assetPath            VARCHAR,
    attributeId          VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
    attributeName        VARCHAR,
    attributeDescription VARCHAR,
    attributeDataType    VARCHAR,
    attributeUnits       VARCHAR,
    pointId              INTEGER,
    pointName            VARCHAR,
    source               VARCHAR,
    PRIMARY KEY (assetMetadataKey)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assetmetadatastaging_assetmetadatakey
    ON AssetMetadataStaging ( assetMetadataKey);

CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS missedpointchanges_id_seq START 1;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS  MissedPointChanges (
    _id                     BIGINT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('missedpointchanges_id_seq'),
    "_model"                VARCHAR,
    "_timestamp"            BIGINT,
    "PipelineName"          VARCHAR,
    "LastRunMaxTime"        TIMESTAMP,
    "CurrentSubscriptionTime" TIMESTAMP,
    "_name"                 VARCHAR,
    "ArrayOfPoints"         VARCHAR,
    "Id"                    VARCHAR
);
Delete from MissedPointChanges where _id = {{this.Id}}
DROP TABLE AssetMetadata
DROP TABLE MissedPointChanges

-- Insert from Parquet
INSERT INTO AssetMetadataStaging
SELECT assetMetadataKey, assetId, assetName, assetPath, attributeId, attributeName, attributeDescription,
       attributeDataType, attributeUnits, pointId, pointName,
       source
FROM read_parquet('{{this.FileName}}')
Select * from MissedPointChanges order by _id
Select * from MissedPointChanges order by _id limit 1

SELECT
    pointID,
    name AS "pointName",
    COALESCE(value_double, value_int64) AS "valueNumber",
    CASE
        WHEN value_double IS NULL AND value_int64 IS NULL
        THEN COALESCE(value_string, CAST(value_boolean AS VARCHAR))
    END AS "valueOther",
    quality,
    time
FROM read_parquet('{{this.FileName}}')
LIMIT {{this.Limit}} OFFSET {{this.Offset}}

SELECT *
FROM read_parquet('{{this.FileName}}')

SELECT *
FROM read_parquet('{{this.FileName}}')
Truncate Table AssetMetadataStaging;
Truncate Table MissedPointChanges;

-- Upsert from AssetMetadataStaging
INSERT INTO AssetMetadata
SELECT nextval('asset_metadata_id_seq'), assetMetadataKey, assetId, assetName, assetPath, attributeId, attributeName, attributeDescription,
       attributeDataType, attributeUnits, pointId, pointName,
       source
FROM AssetMetadataStaging
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY assetMetadataKey) = 1   -- dedupe source
ON CONFLICT (assetMetadataKey) DO UPDATE SET
    assetId            = EXCLUDED.assetId,
    assetName            = EXCLUDED.assetName,
    assetPath            = EXCLUDED.assetPath,
    attributeId            = EXCLUDED.attributeId,
    attributeName        = EXCLUDED.attributeName,
    attributeDescription = EXCLUDED.attributeDescription,
    attributeDataType    = EXCLUDED.attributeDataType,
    attributeUnits       = EXCLUDED.attributeUnits,
    pointId              = EXCLUDED.pointID,
    pointName            = EXCLUDED.pointName,
    source               = EXCLUDED.source

pipelines.name: MissedFromReadPointChangeParquetDatabricks
pipelines.description: This Pipeline executes many times to index through a time period of historical PI Point value changes.  The Pipeline obtains data from PI Data Archive and models the data before formatting it into an array.  The modeled data would typically be written to a file for a data lake or written directly to a data warehouse table.  The dates for the time period and the index interval time are stored in JavaScript Stages that must be edited.  A date is also stored as a State Variable that must be deleted to reset the Pipeline.  The solution relies on a Parquet file that is stored locally.

stages.name: SetIntervalMilliseconds
stages.description: This JavaScript Stage is used to set the time interval for each index and to calculate the end time for the current execution of the Pipeline.

stages.name: SetFileName
stages.description: This JavaScript Stage establishes the name of the file that the Pipeline writes to.

stages.name: while
stages.description: This loop processes each batch of PI Point value changes.

stages.name: SetStartTime

stages.name: PointsParquet
stages.description: The Stage reads the value changes from PI Data Archive for the parameterized start and end time and tag list saved as a reference for the PI Connection Input.

stages.name: WriteFile
stages.description: This Stage writes the payload to a local parquet file.
